results.check: duration 30–40 s
shots in narration order
every graphic points at a player that exists
every anchor falls inside its shot
camera moves smoothly inside shots (≤ 0.9 m per frame)
camera never below 0.8 m
camera stays ≥ 0.5 m from the basket structure
camera never films through the backboard glass (> 10 % of the picture)
every pin label sits on its own player (no other body under it)
highlighted players stay inside the safe frame
planted feet never slide (max drift per 1/120 s)
feet never go under the floor
players3d e2a-player-v1: player meshes present in public/
players3d D: mesh ankle on the engine ankle (≤ 15 mm)
players3d D: planted mesh foot does not slide (≤ 2 mm/frame)
players3d D: ball holder: mesh fingertips on the engine hand point (≤ 40 mm)
players3d D: other players: fingertips vs engine hand (info, arms at full stretch clamp)
players3d D: head never looks up (face pitch ≤ +15°, +35° while a shot is up)
players3d D: head not buried (face pitch ≥ -35°)
players3d D: same time, same bones (seek = playback)
